newsitem.title: UK: Seton in 21.7 mln stg purchase,makes placing.
newsitem.headline: Seton in 21.7 mln stg purchase,makes placing.

text.p: British healthcare and sports products firm Seton Healthcare Group Plc said on Friday it had conditionally acquired DePuy International Ltd for 21.7 million stg.

The company said in a statement that around 16.8 million stg of the cost will be raised by placing 3.61 million shares with institutional investors at 465 pence per share. The balance will be paid in cash.
Subject to the acquisition becoming unconditional Seton will place a further 1.43 million shares, also at 465 pence a share.
The total placing of 5.05 million shares would raise around 23.46 million stg.
The purchase is conditional on the vendor obtaining "taxation clearance related to the sale".

Once completed, DePuy will change its name to ThackrayCare. The company sells branded continence care products, mainly in the UK, where it is the market leader for urinary incontinence sheaths sold by prescription.
Seton also reported a 21 percent jump in pretax profits to 19.81 million stg for the year to February 28, 1997, and an 11 percent increase in the total dividend to 8.8 pence per share.
Turnover exceeded 100 million stg for the first time, up 21 percent at 102.86 million stg.

"Seton's potential and the opportunities for further growth make us optimistic about a future in which all of the stakeholders -- customers, employees, shareholders and suppliers -- will benefit," chairman Norman Stoller said in a statement.
